sara.chen: Heads up — after yesterday's FP8 sweep on staging for redwood-7b-v2 we are seeing nontrivial task deltas. Biggest is a hallucination spike on the legal QA set and some structured-output formatting errors. Rollout was limited to dedicated-low. Anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: deploy completed: fp8-quant-sweep -> pool=dedicated-low, commit=abc123, user=sara.chen
miguel: I pulled the evals this morning. Quick numbers vs float16 baseline: SQuAD EM -6.7%, NER F1 -1.2%, Legal-QA hallucination rate 0.4% -> 3.2%. Structured JSON outputs: valid->invalid increased (12 -> 35 per 1k). Also seeing extra trailing commas in some toolcall responses. Dash: https://dash.redwood/internal/exp/1795
devin: Can you paste a failing example? I'll try to repro locally and check caching behavior.
sara.chen: Sample (redacted):
```
PROMPT: "Given the facts, cite the controlling statute and provide a 3-bullet summary."
RESPONSE (fp8): "According to Section 12(b) of the Federal Code, ..." (section 12(b) does not exist),
RESPONSE STRUCTURE: {"statute": "Section 12(b)", "summary": ["..."],} // note trailing comma + malformed JSON
```
jordan: That looks like an invented citation (hallucination) + formatting issue. My gut: FP8 quant scaling + KV-cache interaction when continuous-batching is on. We've seen token alignment shifts in other fp8 experiments.
ml-bot: auto-eval summary for experiment fp8-quant-sweep (run 2027-01-12): baseline=float16, variant=fp8-gptq
- SQuAD EM: 0.672 -> 0.625 (delta -0.047 = -6.7%)
- LegalQA hallucination rate: 0.004 -> 0.032 (delta +0.028 pp)
- Structured-output parse errors: 12/1k -> 35/1k
- Avg latency change: +4%
lee: Kicking off a targeted bisect of the quant operator kernels. Variants will be: kernel-A(fp8-staging), kernel-B(alt-scaling), kernel-C(fallback-int8). Running against 10k promt set (mix of chat, toolcall, structured outputs). Command: `./tools/bisect_quant --model redwood-7b-v2 --variants A,B,C --evalset repro/10k.json`
miguel: Also observed detokenization token-shifts for long contexts: fields get misaligned in structured outputs when the token count crosses a batch boundary. Could be attention scaling in fp8.
devin: If it's token-shift + kv-cache mismatch, a short-term mitigation is to disable KV caching for fp8 variants in staging and roll back fp8 rollout on dedicated-low. I can push a hotfix to disable caching today. That will mitigate immediate production regressions.
sara.chen: Please keep the failing cases preserved. I'll upload 20 worst failures to the repro gist and tag the examples by failure type (hallucination, json-broken, token-shift). Link incoming: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro-fp8-1795
jordan: Assigning: @devin for hotfix disable-kv-cache, @lee for kernel bisect. I'll monitor perf and update SLO impact. Thanks :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: release action: rollback-kv-cache-fp8 initiated by devin at 1795001287. Status: in-progress.
